stories.headline: Accenture built an eval system directly into Claude's API
stories.blurb: Anthropic and Accenture created a way to run evaluations on AI outputs without ever leaving the Claude API call. Instead of building separate testing infrastructure, developers can now specify eval criteria in the same request that generates the response—Claude scores itself in real time.
stories.why_it_matters: Makes testing AI outputs as simple as adding a parameter to your API call.
stories.original_headline: Partnering with Accenture on embedded evaluation

stories.headline: Anthropic just opened a lab where AI runs its own biology experiments
stories.blurb: The company behind Claude now operates a physical wet lab where AI agents design and execute biology experiments autonomously. It's the first time a major AI lab has moved from predicting protein structures to actually pipetting reagents and running assays in the real world.
stories.why_it_matters: AI went from reading biology papers to doing the benchwork itself.
stories.original_headline: Anthropic is operating a lab that conducts biology experiments

stories.headline: California governor wants an AI kill switch for frontier models
stories.blurb: Gavin Newsom issued an executive order directing California to convene experts who'll recommend within two months how to mandate emergency shutoffs for advanced AI systems. The state is positioning itself to lead AI oversight after Newsom vetoed a similar bill last year.
stories.why_it_matters: California could set the template for how states regulate AI model deployment and safety controls.
stories.original_headline: Gavin Newsom is pushing for an AI kill switch

stories.headline: Trump proposes renaming AI and launching a new 'AI Force'
stories.blurb: The former president says he wants to rebrand artificial intelligence with a new name and establish a government 'AI Force,' while claiming without evidence that concerns about AI risks are a Democratic hoax. No details on what either initiative would actually involve.
stories.why_it_matters: Policy proposals this vague rarely move markets, but they signal how AI is becoming a political talking point.
stories.original_headline: Trump says it’s time to rebrand AI with a new name — and he’s also creating an AI Force
